text: nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ . evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti . [193] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . seyyathāpi bhikkhave yamunā nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā . evameva kho bhikkhave
